content: क्षर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> [क्षरति-क्षरित] (Used transitively or intransitively) .²1 To flow, glide. .²2 To send or stream forth, pour out, emit; तेषु क्षरत्सु बहुधा मदवारिधाराः <ls>R. 13. 74</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 8</ls>. .²3 To drop, trickle, ooze. .²4 To waste away, wane, perish. .²5 To become useless, have no effect; यज्ञोऽनृतेन क्षरति तपः क्षरति विस्मयात् <ls>Ms. 4. 237</ls>. .²6 To melt. .²7 To slip from, be deprived of (with <ab>abl.</ab>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (क्षारयति-ते) To accuse, traduce (usually with आ). --{%With%} {@वि@} to melt away, dissolve.
